mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0% and rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in monthly job gains signal a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, strong housing starts (HOUST above 500,000 units) signal robust consumer demand and confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy avoids a near-term recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 500.0 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity and potential economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 335,000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves rapidly.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 335.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), weak labor market conditions suppress consumer spending and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signal inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates decline and market uncertainty rises.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.
